name: Doona Car Seat & Stroller

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. carrierLb/fitsWayfinder/fitsAlterrain/safety map into seed.json; the rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: Integrated car-seat -> stroller (wheels fold out in one motion); 5-pt harness + anti-rebound LATCH base; crash-tested 100+ times, NHTSA 5-star, meets/exceeds US & EU standards
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: N/A — Doona is its own stroller; no infant-seat-to-stroller adapter exists or applies
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: N/A — Doona is its own stroller; no adapter applies
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No Tacoma-specific fitment data found. As a car seat it installs rear-facing on its own LATCH base; the integrated wheels/frame add bulk but its in-car footprint is comparable to a standard infant seat. Heaviest carrier in the roster (~16.5 lb; Target lists 17.2 lb), but light for a full travel system (vs. ~20+ lb for a separate seat + stroller).

notes: FLAG (c) RESOLVED: BOB compatibility is N/A — the Doona IS its own stroller (car seat with integrated fold-out wheels), so no BOB Wayfinder/Alterrain adapter applies. Cross-module note for integration: the Doona competes with the STROLLER module too, not just car-seats — it's the only true 2-in-1 (car seat + stroller in one) on the roster, so its value should be judged against travel-system combos, not bare infant seats. Pricing is uniform at $650.00 (in stock at Target, Babylist, and Doona DTC); higher-end colorways (e.g. Midnight Edition) run $750. seed stub price 550 is now low vs. the $650 street price.
